name: Process inbox
description: Turn uncategorized captures into tasks, memories, artifacts, or PARA bucket placements.

nodes.label: Collect inbox
nodes.description: Gather uncategorized notes, links, files, and reminders that need routing.

artifact.description: Batch of inbox items to process.

nodes.label: Triage items
nodes.description: For each item, decide delete, defer, delegate, task, memory, artifact, or reference.

artifact.description: Triage decision for each inbox item.

nodes.label: Assign buckets
nodes.description: Assign retained items to concrete PARA buckets using para:<bucket>/<slug> tags.

artifact.description: PARA bucket assignment for retained inbox items.

nodes.label: Create outputs
nodes.description: Create tasks, memories, or artifacts for retained items; discard or archive the rest.

artifact.description: Created tasks, memories, artifacts, and discarded items.

nodes.label: Close batch
nodes.description: Confirm the inbox batch is empty or only contains intentionally deferred items.

artifact.description: Closeout note for the processed inbox batch.
